scripts.typecheck: for pkg in packages/shared packages/main packages/preload; do echo "--- typechecking $pkg ---" && bun run --cwd $pkg typecheck; done
scripts.clean: find . -name 'dist' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -maxdepth 3 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
